---
title: "Reveal.js format"
subtitle: "Presentation decks with ground slides and a three slot footer."
description: "What mcanouil-revealjs gives a deck: the slide size, the title, section, dark and closing slides, speakers, the footer, and the embedded Reveal.js tools."
---

```yaml
title: "Quarto extensions"
subtitle: "Build, share and maintain your own formats"
author: Mickaël Canouil
date: 2026-07-08
format: mcanouil-revealjs
extensions:
  mcanouil:
    event: "useR! 2026 · Warwick"
    speakers:
      - photo: speaker.jpg
        alt: "Portrait of Mickaël Canouil"
    closing:
      links:
        - mickael.canouil.fr
        - github.com/mcanouil
      licence: "Slides: m.canouil.dev/user2026 · CC BY 4.0"
```

## Slide size

Slides are 1280 by 720 pixels, with `margin: 0`, so that the motif reaches the slide edges.
A deck from an earlier version of the extension shows at a different scale.

## Slide types

- Title slide: the event as a kicker, the title, a gilded rule, the subtitle, the speakers and the date.
- Section slide: a level 1 heading gives a slide on the dark ground with a large section number.
- Content slide: a level 2 heading.
- Dark slide: add `.dark` to a level 2 heading. The slide uses the dark tokens of the preset.
- Closing slide: from the `closing` option, on the dark ground.

```markdown
# Checks

## Why presets, after dark {.dark}
```

The title, section and closing slides always use the dark ground.
Long titles get a smaller size, so they do not touch the motif.
`brand-mode: dark` makes every slide dark.

## Speakers

`speakers` holds one entry for each author, in the order of the authors.
`photo` is an image file, relative to the document.
The deck embeds the photo.
A photo without `alt` gives a warning.

## Closing slide

`closing: true` adds a closing slide with the title "Thank you" in the document language.
A map sets its parts:

| Key | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | Title of the slide. |
| `links` | Links, one per line. |
| `licence` | Licence line. |

: The parts of the closing slide. {.striped .hover tbl-colwidths="[20,80]"}

The links show as plain text, so they read in a PDF export too.

## Footer

The default footer shows the speaker and the event, the talk title, and the slide number.
The title and closing slides have no footer, slide number or progress bar.
Section slides keep the footer.
See [Header and footer](../reference.qmd#header-and-footer).

## Embedded Reveal.js tools

- [revealjs-cascade](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-revealjs-cascade) repeats the heading chain on continuation slides that start with `---`.
- [revealjs-codefrag](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-revealjs-codefrag) steps through code annotations as fragments.
- [revealjs-tabset](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-revealjs-tabset) makes tabsets work in decks.
- [veil](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-veil) hides blocks until the presenter shows them.

Read the documentation of each tool for its syntax.
Do not add them to `filters:` or `revealjs-plugins:`: the format already loads them.
